info.desc: "Grace Under Pressure" is the tenth studio album by Canadian rock band Rush, released April 12, 1984, on Anthem Records. After touring for the band's previous album, "Signals" (1982), ended in mid-1983, Rush began work on a follow-up that August. The group chose not to continue with longtime producer Terry Brown, who had worked with them since 1974. The new material furthered the band's shift toward a synthesizer-focused sound, a direction established on "Signals." After encountering challenges securing a producer with the right availability and approach, the band ultimately recorded the album with Peter Henderson. "Grace Under Pressure" reached number .

podcast.body: The album "Grace Under Pressure" featured the song "The Enemy Within," for which the music video was the first to be shown on MuchMusic, Canada's first 24-hour music channel. This premiere was part of MuchMusic's live launch event on August 31, 1984. "The first video shown on Much Music was The Enemy Within. From Rush's new album, Grace Under Pressure."
